title: vitis reticulata
intro: Vitis reticulata, commonly known as the Chinese grapevine, is a plant species native to China and parts of Asia. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Vitis reticulata include wound healing, anti-aging, and anti-cancer effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The bioactive constituents of Vitis reticulata also exhibit cardiovascular protective and neuroprotective properties, supporting its use in traditional Chinese medicine.
